title: I Let My Neighbor Keep the Immersion Blender Until the Quiet Portal Logged It

parts.text: I loaned the immersion blender on Sunday and the quiet portal said seventy-two hours. Thursday morning it was still on their drying rack. I was thirty-four, neighbor, standing in a hallway that made me look like I owned the ask. I photographed the portal, the due line, and the blender still wet. Then I let the portal ping. At 9:18 their fob logged an overdue return. I kept my voice indoor and let the timestamp talk. They brought it down with a towel. Building policy now has a second line: LOANS CLOSE WHEN THE PORTAL SAYS. I keep the blender on a labeled hook. The hallway finally looks like a due date, not a maybe.

social.description: Seventy-two hours, a wet rack, a hallway ping. Would you have let the portal talk?
